body: **Decision (person, relayed by orchestrator, 2026-10-31).** Sprint 2 entry criterion n1 is still open: no GitHub OAuth App client ID has been posted. The person chose to build DM-141 and its dependents now against a placeholder. `GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID` ships empty, and sign-in fails fast with `sign_in_misconfigured` (no network call) until a person registers the OAuth App (Device Flow enabled) and posts its client ID here. c5 is reported **not met** until then, and so is sprint 2 exit criterion e1, which keeps the sprint 2 gate closed.
